registry.description: MCP server registry: list_mcp_servers tool, GET /registry (JSON), GET /list (HTML) for this deployment's MCP servers.

dqm.description: Read-only MCP server for Mu2e DQM metrics via Query Engine over HTTP (dqm.sources/values/intervals/numbers/limits).

metacat.description: Read-only MCP server for Mu2e metacat dataset/file discovery (discover_datasets, get_dataset_details, query_dataset_files).

arxiv.description: Read-only MCP server for arXiv paper search (search_papers, get_paper), via the public arXiv Atom API.

inspirehep.description: Read-only MCP server for INSPIRE-HEP literature/author/citation search, via the public INSPIRE-HEP REST API.

ecl.description: Streamable-HTTP MCP server for the Fermilab ECL logbook, read-only by default (ecl_search_entries, ecl_get_entry, ecl_list_categories/tags/forms).

runs.description: Read-only MCP server for the Mu2e run database via runTool (get_run, list_runs, get_flags, get_dbtables, get_cidtables, get_config_blob).

memory.description: Persistent project memory for agents, stored in Postgres: put_document, get_document, list_documents, list_versions, list_projects, set_metadata. Documents are private to the owner named by the caller's token.
